entities.summary: Yudy Macarena Valdés Muñoz was a Mapuche human rights activist who led a campaign against the construction of a hydroelectric plant on the Tranguil River. Following her death, she has been compared to other murdered South American female activists including Berta Cáceres and Marielle Franco.
